男女ペアでの画像お願いします。男のほうは送ったURLが特徴です。女性のほうは特徴的には男と似たようなキャラが良いです。男が後ろから抱きしめてるようなら画像で、お互いタバコを吸ってるような感じでお願いします。
首に青い薔薇のタトゥーお願いします。

Hello sensei! I saw your drawings and I thought they are very beautiful, so I would like to ask you for an illustration.
The request is as follows, I hope you'll consider it.

■Request content
These two people are my OCs, and I'd like to ask you to draw the Prophet and Werewolf costumes provided in the URL.
Please feel free to play around with the composition and scope while conforming to the worldview, as long as it shows the relationship between the two★

■Roles
💙Glasses man: 19 years old / male / 174 cm / dark blue hair, blue eyes
The young prophet is not good at words himself, but is more confident in the presence of familiar people. The mind is good, because the learned command comes to the village to look for werewolves, but is not trusted by the local residents.
❤️Dark-haired man: 19 / Male / 180 cm / Dark hair, red eyes, mole around his mouth.
He's a normal human by day and a werewolf by night. Hidden in the villagers, because good at communication, self-confidence，cheerful and enthusiastic, coupled with his own knowledge, so it is very popular among residents.

■ Relationships
When the glasses man was in trouble, the brunette man helped the glasses man. The two became close friends because they were equally educated and enjoyed reading and doing research. But the black-haired man to the glasses man has been hiding his werewolf identity, has been restrained werewolf instinct; The glasses man was aware, but did not want to suspect the identity of the brunette man.

■Use: Personal viewing

Would like to receive a resend request if adjustments are needed due to amount or other reasons > <
Thank you for reading！

Nice to meet you!
I have seen your drawings and I love the atmosphere of your drawings!
I would like to commission you to draw my original character.


▶Personality
Lazy and painstaking person. He is a 17 year old boy with a strong of balance and decisiveness. He grew up on the battlefield and spent his childhood as a mercenary. Now he works for a security company. (The motif of him's tribal is vampire.)



▶Situations, etc.
We leave it up to you.


▶Composition, clothing, etc.
I will leave this to you too. We would be very happy if the composition includes the whole body.
He is wearing a dirty cloak over a sloppy shirt. He wears straight trousers underneath and shoes that look like tactical boots.
I would like him hair to look like the reference, but I will leave it up to Yonao-sama's preference.
Skin color is white.
Ears are pointed like elf ears.
The color of her eyes is black, but as a difference, I would like them to be red and have a crisp expression.



▶Size
We will leave it to you.


▶Use
Use for TRPG sessions



▶Other notes
It would be very helpful if you could separate the background, writing, background transparency, with background, with writing, without writing, and difference status.
PSD data would be very helpful!

Thank you for reading and your consideration!

▶References

Hello! You've got a really nice art style, can I request you draw a character of mine? I've attached some references to better explain what I intend, labeled like [ref 1], [ref 2-4], etc, as they come up.
The general theme of the character is she's an emotionally cold bartender that also works as a hitman/sniper.
I would like her to be wearing a white dress shirt with a black vest and black tie, akin to [ref 1-2], as well as plain black suit pants and shoes, like [ref 3]. She is generally flat chested. Any external bits and highlights such as buttons can be golden.
She has gold eyes, with her right pupil being like a crosshair, specifically [ref 4].
Her hairstyle is generally short, with a ponytail, a mixture of [ref 5] and [ref 6-7]. Taking the front of her hair from [ref 5], with the ponytail and the side bits of hair falling in front of her chest like [ref 6-7]. Additionally, I'd like there to be a strip of a golden highlight in her hair, placement does not matter.
She carries either a briefcase or a gun, specifically a WA2000. (pictured in [ref 8-9].) You do not need to draw the gun if you deem it too complex or extra to the design. It is entirely acceptable to have her carrying a briefcase instead, with the handle and metallic rim being golden. If you choose the briefcase, it does not have to be as large as the gun, it can be normal-sized.
